one_line: Nvidia leadership changes follow Jensen Huang's resignation, while OpenAI launches agent shopping tools and security products.

themes.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
themes.text: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned after admitting to relationships with a subordinate and a spy, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO while the board approaches Arm CEO Rene Haas. The departure has caused concern among Wall Street, investors, and startups regarding the future of Nvidia's aggressive dealmaking and financing strategies.

Nvidia approaches Arm CEO Haas as employees seek Huang's return
Report details past clash between Jensen Huang and interim CEO Colette Kress
Wall Street fears Jensen Huang's ouster will slow Nvidia's AI dealmaking
Start-up investors and founders worry about losing ally in Jensen Huang
Congressional Democrats launch inquiry into Nvidia China chip sales and Trump deal
Jensen Huang misled Nvidia leaders about relationship with Alice Huang
Nvidia reportedly funded AI startups to absorb excess GPU supply

themes.title: OpenAI and Amazon advance AI agents
themes.text: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet to enable AI agent shopping and introduced Daybreak security products for application vulnerability testing. Meanwhile, Amazon drafted plans for a World Product Graph to index global product data for AI search, and OpenAI disbanded its standalone robotics team.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security products
OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent shopping
Amazon plans World Product Graph to index global product data for AI agents
OpenAI disbands standalone robotics team as general models take over

themes.title: Infrastructure, outages, and financial updates
themes.text: AI cloud provider Nscale reported $5.5 billion in debt and a $1.69 billion net loss in an amended IPO filing, while ReNew pledged ₹80,000 crore for green data centers in Andhra Pradesh. Additionally, a global Microsoft outage disrupted Copilot and cloud services, and SpaceX laid off staff from its Grok Imagine team.
